attribution: NOAA National Data Buoy Center, station 46086, San Clemente Basin; frozen marine-gyro export.

station.name: San Clemente Basin, Southern California
station.scope: Deep offshore Southern California Bight point reference; does not represent every coastal or island-sheltered fishing ground.

coverage: 0.03–0.495 Hz measured; unmeasured tails unknown; .020-Hz noise band excluded.

units.direction_moments: int16/32767; (a1,b1,a2,b2), FROM clockwise from true north

selection.method: Nearest joint Hm0/Tm02 target in observed IQR units; earliest UTC tie; median first, then targets in Hm0/Tm02 quantile order .5,.1,.9; previously selected hours excluded.
selection.descriptors: Hm0=4sqrt(m0); Tm02=sqrt(m0/m2); uniform density within each retained interval.
selection.note: Nine coverage examples, not population weights or independent marginal draws.
